structural_breaks.note: FY2018 annual report restates FY2017 营业收入 10,330.72 → 10,329.49 (−1.23m, retrospective presentation adjustment; immaterial). FY2017 quarterly points keep the as-published 2017 AR quarterly table.

同一控制下企业合并 during H1 2020: FY2019 restated 10,156.08 → 10,852.45 (+696.36m, +6.9%); H1 2019 3,054.49 → 3,317.46; 9M 2019 5,238.22 → 5,658.88. The FY2020 AR quarterly table restates FY2020Q1 to 1,023.33 (Q1 report as published: 917.40, comparative 1,032.57 old scope) — so FY2020Q1/Q2/Q4 YoY vs FY2019 points mixes scopes (no like-for-like 3-month comparative printed; Q1 comparative therefore omitted). FY2020Q3 carries the same-scope comparative 2,341.42 from the Q3 report.

同一控制下企业合并 + 会计政策变更 recognised in FY2023 AR: FY2022 restated 14,917.45 → 15,029.74 (+112.29m, +0.75%); FY2023 quarterly table restated in-year (Q1 3,263.67 → 3,308.77; H1 7,114.26 → 7,203.04; 9M 10,663.89 → 10,829.98). FY2023 quarters therefore have no same-scope printed comparative; YoY vs FY2022 points is biased up by ≈1%. FY2024 reports print restated FY2023 comparatives equal to the FY2023 quarterly table.

profile.products: Per FY2025 annual report (p.11-13): six product groups — 智能变配电系统 (relay protection, substation monitoring/automation, smart-substation systems, distribution terminals & DA systems), 直流输电系统 (±1100kV UHVDC and ±800kV VSC-HVDC converter valves, DC measurement, DC control & protection), 智能电表 (smart meters, terminals, AMI, MCBs), 智能中压供用电设备 (switchgear, transformers, reactors, arc-suppression-coil grounding sets, ring-main units), 新能源及系统集成 (PV/storage EPC & integration, grid-forming PCS, hydrogen power supplies), 充换电设备及其它制造服务 (EV chargers incl. liquid-cooled ultra-fast, battery swap, EMS contract manufacturing). FY2024 revenue split: 智能变配电 4,711m (27.6%), 智能电表 3,866m, 智能中压供用电 3,352m (19.6%), 新能源及系统集成 2,464m, 直流输电 1,444m, 充换电及其它 1,252m. Transformer exposure is small: subsidiary 许继变压器有限公司 (78%) revenue 1,134.95m in FY2025 (1,212.81m FY2024) per AR note.

profile.end_markets: State Grid / China Southern Grid (controlling shareholder is 中国电气装备集团, which also controls China XD), UHV AC/DC projects, renewables & storage, rail transit, EV charging, industrial. Overseas sales small (国际 309.49m = 1.81% of FY2024 revenue).

gaps: prior_year_comparative stored only where a same-scope 3-month comparative is printed: Q1 (Q1 report 上年同期) and Q3 2015-2020 (old-format Q3 report 7-9月 利润表). Omitted for FY2020Q1 and FY2023Q1 because the annual quarterly table was restated in-year (different scope from the Q1 report that printed the comparative).

revenue_segment: not stored. XJ prints product revenue (e.g. 智能中压供用电设备, which contains switchgear AND transformers) semi-annually, but (a) no product line isolates transformers and (b) several H1/AR tables have wrapped labels that could not be read reliably; transformer subsidiary 许继变压器 revenue is disclosed only annually.
orders_segment: XJ does not disclose order intake in periodic reports.
collection_notes: Primary sources: XJ periodic reports (一季报/半年报/三季报/年报) PDF from cninfo static host. Extraction: pypdf + pdfplumber; values = annual report 分季度主要财务指标 (3-month figures) for FY2015-FY2025, FY2026Q1 from the Q1 report, FY2026Q2 = H1 − Q1.
Checks: Σ quarters = FY 营业收入 each year (exact); Q1/H1/9M/Q3 match quarterly reports except the documented restatement years (2020, 2023).
XJ 营业收入 is used (not 营业总收入).

Validator 3x-change warnings (Q4→Q1 and some Q1→Q2) are genuine: XJ revenue is strongly Q4-weighted (grid customers accept deliveries at year-end); every flagged value is confirmed by Σ4Q = FY and by the quarterly reports.
